repos.description: A list of Free Software network services and web applications which can be hosted on your own servers
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个全面的自托管开源软件目录，涵盖通信、存储、管理、媒体等数十个类别，提供替代SaaS的私有化部署方案。核心价值在于帮助用户实现数据主权、隐私保护和基础设施自主可控。项目持续维护，包含死链检查和活跃度监控，是自建服务器的终极参考指南。
repos.summary_en: A comprehensive directory of self-hostable open-source network services and web applications spanning communications, storage, management, media, and dozens of categories. It enables private deployment alternatives to SaaS, empowering data sovereignty, privacy protection, and infrastructure autonomy. Continuously maintained with automated dead link validation and project health monitoring, it serves as the definitive reference for building and maintaining a self-hosted server ecosystem.

repos.description: The open-source CapCut alternative
repos.summary_zh: OpenCut 是开源的 CapCut 替代品，提供 Web、桌面和移动端视频编辑。基于 Next.js 和 React 构建，采用 Zustand 状态管理与 TypeScript 类型安全。支持时间线多轨道编辑和实时预览，核心优势是隐私优先（视频本地处理）、无订阅费用和水印，为商业闭源编辑器提供强大替代方案。
repos.summary_en: OpenCut is a free, open-source alternative to CapCut that provides comprehensive video editing capabilities for web, desktop, and mobile platforms. Built on Next.js and React with Zustand state management, it delivers timeline-based multi-track editing with real-time preview. The project emphasizes privacy by processing videos entirely on-device, eliminating subscriptions and watermarks. Leveraging TypeScript, Bun, and Docker, OpenCut offers a streamlined development experience and a robust, privacy-first substitute for commercial video editing solutions.

repos.description: A privacy-first app that strips AI watermarks from content you own.
repos.summary_zh: 隐私优先的开源工具，作为Agent技能与纯标准库Python HTTP服务，精准剥离多厂商AI溯源水印（Unicode隐形字符、统计token标记、C2PA/EXIF等元数据）。支持文本、图像、文档、音视频等格式，专为用户自有内容的隐私卫生设计，兼容Claude/Gemini/OpenAI及开源LLM，零依赖核心运行。
repos.summary_en: Privacy-first open-source tool combining an agent skill with a pure-stdlib Python HTTP service to strip multi-vendor AI provenance watermarks from text and files you own. Handles invisible Unicode, statistical token marks, and C2PA/EXIF/XMP metadata across images, docs, audio/video. Supports Claude, Gemini, OpenAI and open LLMs with zero-dependency core.

repos.description: SimpleX - the first messaging network operating without user identifiers of any kind - 100% private by design! iOS, Android and desktop apps 📱!
repos.summary_zh: SimpleX Chat是首个无任何用户标识符的消息平台，100%隐私设计，保护消息内容及元数据（通话对象与时间）。采用SMP协议通过单向匿名队列实现去中心化通信，支持用户自建服务器。具备双棘轮E2EE加密、多层防护、带外密钥交换、群组通话等功能。提供iOS、Android、桌面及CLI跨平台应用，适用于隐私敏感用户防范监控与垃圾信息场景。技术亮点包括便携加密存储和Tor支持。
repos.summary_en: SimpleX is the first messaging network operating without any user identifiers whatsoever, providing 100% privacy by design through protection of both message content and metadata. Built on the SimpleX Messaging Protocol (SMP), it uses unidirectional queues with pairwise anonymous addresses for decentralized, server-relayed communication where anyone can host servers. It features double-ratchet end-to-end encryption augmented with additional layers, out-of-band key exchange via links or QR codes, support for encrypted groups, calls, files, and optional Tor access. Cross-platform apps for iOS, Android, desktop, and terminal CLI enable portable encrypted data storage. Ideal for users prioritizing metadata privacy and spam resistance in secure communications.

repos.description: The most intuitive desktop API client. Organize and execute REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, Server Sent Events, and gRPC 🦬
repos.summary_zh: Yaak 是一款隐私优先的跨平台桌面 API 客户端，全面支持 REST、GraphQL、WebSocket、SSE 和 gRPC 协议。基于 Tauri 框架构建，后端采用 Rust 实现高性能与安全性，前端使用 React 提供流畅交互。通过社区许可模式运营，为开发者提供直观、高效的 API 调试与管理解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Yaak is a privacy-first cross-platform desktop API client supporting REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, SSE, and gRPC protocols. Built on Tauri framework with Rust backend and React frontend, it delivers high-performance API debugging experience. Community-funded through license purchases, it offers intuitive interface for developers to organize, test, and manage APIs efficiently.

repos.description: Technitium DNS Server
repos.summary_zh: Technitium DNS Server 是开源跨平台权威/递归DNS服务器，支持自托管以提升隐私与安全。开箱即用，提供Web控制台，可网络级拦截广告与恶意软件，支持DoT/DoH/DoQ加密协议、集群管理、LDAP/OIDC认证及高性能异步IO。适用于家庭与企业网络，内置缓存、DNSSEC与应用扩展框架，显著提升解析速度与控制力。
repos.summary_en: Technitium DNS Server is an open-source cross-platform authoritative and recursive DNS server for self-hosting with strong privacy and security focus. It works out-of-the-box with a web console, enables network-wide ad/malware blocking, supports DoT/DoH/DoQ encrypted protocols, clustering, LDAP/OIDC auth, and high-performance async I/O. Ideal for home and enterprise networks, featuring advanced caching, DNSSEC, and an apps framework for enhanced control and speed.

repos.description: The open-source, privacy-friendly CAPTCHA you host yourself. Bots and AI agents out, people in.
repos.summary_zh: Cap 是一款隐私优先的自托管验证码替代方案，采用 SHA-256 工作量证明机制，摒弃传统视觉 puzzles。仅 20KB 大小，零依赖，加载毫秒级，支持 Docker 独立部署。提供隐形验证与 M2M API 保护能力，通过 CSS 变量实现深度定制，为现代 Web 应用提供高效、私密的 bot 防护。
repos.summary_en: Cap is a privacy-first, self-hosted CAPTCHA alternative that replaces visual puzzles with SHA-256 proof-of-work challenges. At just 20KB with zero dependencies, it loads in milliseconds and supports standalone Docker deployment. Featuring invisible validation, M2M API protection, and CSS variable customization, it provides efficient, private bot mitigation for modern web applications.

repos.description: ⚠️ Browser fingerprinting via favicon!
repos.summary_zh: Supercookie 通过 favicon 缓存机制实现浏览器持久指纹追踪，为访客分配独特且难以清除的 ID。该 ID 在隐身模式、清除缓存、重启系统或使用 VPN/AdBlocker 后仍有效。项目仅用于教育演示，旨在揭示 favicon 跟踪的隐私风险。技术亮点包括跨会话持久性、实时 API 演示及 Node.js/Docker 部署，适用于隐私安全研究与开发者警示。
repos.summary_en: Supercookie demonstrates persistent browser fingerprinting via favicon caching, assigning unique, hard-to-clear IDs to visitors. The ID survives incognito mode, cache clears, browser restarts, VPNs, and ad blockers. Built for educational purposes only, it highlights privacy risks from favicon tracking. Key features include cross-session persistence, live demo APIs, and easy deployment with Node.js and Docker, ideal for security research and awareness.

repos.description: An Xposed module to intercept applist detections
repos.summary_zh: 基于Xposed框架的Android隐私保护模块，通过拦截应用列表请求隐藏已安装应用，防止其他应用检测Root工具来识别设备Root状态，同时抵御基于应用列表的指纹追踪，并提供隐藏效果验证功能。
repos.summary_en: An Xposed module for Android that intercepts app list requests to hide installed applications from other apps. It prevents apps from detecting root-related tools (such as Fake Location or Storage Isolation) that would reveal a device is rooted. Additionally, it blocks apps from using app list enumeration as fingerprinting data or for other nefarious purposes. The module also provides built-in verification methods to test whether app list hiding is working properly, ensuring comprehensive privacy protection on rooted Android devices.

repos.description: Use any LLMs (Large Language Models) for Deep Research. Support SSE API and MCP server.
repos.summary_zh: Deep Research是一个隐私优先的深度研究工具，支持Gemini、OpenAI、Deepseek等主流大模型，可在2分钟内生成综合性研究报告。核心亮点包括：浏览器端本地数据处理确保隐私安全；支持Searxng、Tavily等搜索引擎；提供知识图谱构建和本地知识库管理；支持MCP服务器和SSE API。基于Next.js构建，可一键部署至Vercel或Cloudflare，适用于快速调研和知识整理场景。
repos.summary_en: Deep Research is a privacy-first deep research tool that leverages multiple LLMs (Gemini, OpenAI, Deepseek, etc.) to generate comprehensive reports in approximately 2 minutes. Key features include local browser-side data processing for privacy, integration with search engines like Searxng and Tavily, knowledge graph generation, and local knowledge base management. Built with Next.js, it supports MCP server and SSE API, offering one-click deployment to Vercel or Cloudflare. Ideal for rapid research and knowledge organization with full data control.

repos.description: The RethinkDNS resolver that deploys to Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy, Fastly, and Fly.io
repos.summary_zh: Serverless-dns 是一个自托管的无服务器 DNS 解析器，提供类似 Pi-Hole 的内容过滤功能，支持 DNS-over-HTTPS 和 DNS-over-TLS。它可一键部署到 Cloudflare Workers、Deno Deploy、Fastly 和 Fly.io 等边缘平台，利用其免费层即可满足10-20台设备的日常需求。服务器处理延迟仅0-2毫秒，端到端延迟中位数为10-30毫秒，具备全球覆盖能力。
repos.summary_en: Serverless-dns is a self-hosted, serverless DNS resolver with Pi-Hole-like content blocking, supporting DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) and DNS-over-TLS (DoT). It deploys effortlessly to edge platforms including Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy, Fastly, and Fly.io. The free tiers suffice for 10-20 devices monthly. Server processing takes 0-2ms, with end-to-end latency of 10-30ms (median), enabling global low-latency DNS resolution.

repos.description: An open source fingerprint browser based on Ungoogled Chromium. 指纹浏览器 隐私浏览器
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个基于Ungoogled Chromium开源项目的隐私浏览器，专门设计用于对抗浏览器指纹追踪。项目提供Chromium 138至144多个版本的预编译二进制文件，全面支持Windows、Linux和macOS平台。通过深度移除Google服务组件并强化反指纹采集机制，有效保护用户隐私，适用于需要高匿名性的网络访问和多账号管理场景。
repos.summary_en: This is an open-source privacy browser based on Ungoogled Chromium, specifically engineered to resist browser fingerprinting. The project offers pre-compiled binaries for Chromium versions 138 through 144, supporting Windows, Linux, and macOS. By deeply removing Google services and enhancing anti-fingerprinting protections, it effectively prevents fingerprint collection while maintaining Chromium's core functionality. Perfect for anonymous browsing and multi-account management requiring strong privacy controls.

repos.description: Your Self-Hosted Knowledge Base
repos.summary_zh: NoteDiscovery 是一款轻量级自托管笔记与知识库应用，强调数据隐私与所有权。采用纯 Markdown 文件存储，支持知识图谱可视化、LaTeX 数学、Mermaid 图表、内置绘图编辑器及插件扩展。通过 MCP 协议实现与 Claude、Cursor 等 AI 助手的深度集成，支持笔记搜索、创建与组织。提供美观响应式界面、可选认证和多语言支持，是 Notion、Obsidian 的免费开源替代方案，适合开发者、知识工作者及隐私敏感用户，Docker 一键部署，无订阅费用与厂商锁定。
repos.summary_en: NoteDiscovery is a lightweight self-hosted note-taking and knowledge base application that empowers users with full control over their data. Notes are stored as plain Markdown files, featuring an elegant web UI with graph visualization, LaTeX/MathJax support, Mermaid diagrams, a drawing editor, and extensive customization via themes and plugins. It stands out with MCP integration for AI tools like Claude and Cursor, enabling direct note search, creation, and organization. Responsive across devices with optional auth and multi-language support, it serves as a free, open-source alternative to Notion or Obsidian for privacy-focused developers and knowledge workers, with effortless Docker deployment and zero subscriptions or lock-in.

repos.description: Advanced Privacy Browser Core with Unified Fingerprint Defense: Cloudflare, Akamai, Kasada, Shape, DataDome, PerimeterX, hCaptcha, FunCaptcha, Imperva, reCAPTCHA, ThreatMetrix, Adscore
repos.summary_zh: BotBrowser是一款专注于反浏览器指纹追踪的隐私浏览器核心。基于最新Chromium构建，通过统一指纹防御技术，在Windows、macOS、Linux等跨平台环境下保持完全一致的指纹特征，有效对抗Cloudflare、Akamai、Kasada等31+种高级追踪检测机制。支持Playwright/Puppeteer集成，提供QUIC/STUN全代理网络栈和毫秒级独立指纹切换，性能损耗低于1%。适用于隐私研究、反欺诈测试和自动化工具开发。
repos.summary_en: BotBrowser is a privacy-first browser core engineered to neutralize browser fingerprinting across platforms. Built on the latest Chromium, it maintains identical fingerprint signatures on Windows, macOS, and Linux, defeating over 31 tracking systems including Cloudflare, Akamai, and Kasada. Key features include Playwright/Puppeteer integration with CDP leak blocking, full QUIC/STUN proxy tunneling, per-context fingerprint isolation with millisecond switching, and benchmark-proven performance parity with Chrome. Designed for privacy research and authorized defensive benchmarking.

repos.description: Secure, production-grade IoT hydroponic automation system with ESP32, MQTT telemetry, and real-time dashboard
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个生产级开源物联网水培自动化系统，基于ESP32硬件和MQTT协议实现pH、EC、温湿度等环境参数实时监测与智能控制。系统采用React+Node.js构建边缘优先的实时仪表板，通过InfluxDB存储时序数据，支持TLS加密通信和RSA签名OTA更新，填补了业余DIY与工业级自动化之间的空白。
repos.summary_en: HydroponicOne is a production-grade open-source IoT automation system for hydroponic farming, built on ESP32 hardware and MQTT telemetry protocol. It enables real-time monitoring and automated control of critical parameters including pH, EC, water level, temperature, and humidity through smart relays for dosing pumps, lights, and ventilation. The system features an edge-first React dashboard with WebSocket communication, enterprise-grade security with TLS encryption and RSA-2048 signed OTA updates, and dual-database architecture (PostgreSQL for config, InfluxDB for time-series data). It bridges the gap between hobbyist DIY setups and expensive industrial automation solutions.

repos.description: Local-first, open-source Claude Science alternative, before Claude Science is a thing. Turn your AI agent into personal DNA expert.
repos.summary_zh: Genomi 是开源 AI 代理运行时，将 AI 代理转变为个人 DNA 专家。它提供本地私有工作空间，包括 Active Genome Index 存储变异数据、公共遗传证据查询、探索记忆和报告工具，实现证据支持的 DNA 问题解答。基因组数据完全本地保留，支持 MCP 兼容主机如 Claude，解析原始 DNA 文件，回答健康风险、药物反应、遗传特征等问题，并随研究自更新。保障隐私的个性化基因组分析。
repos.summary_en: Genomi is an open-source AI agent runtime that turns your AI agent into a personal DNA expert. It provides a private local workspace with an Active Genome Index for variants, public genetics evidence queries, exploration memory, and report tools for evidence-backed answers. Genome data stays on-device. Compatible with MCP hosts like Claude, it parses raw DNA files, enables local querying on health risks, medication responses and traits, and self-updates with latest research for secure, personalized genomic insights.

repos.description: Markdown editor that gets out of your way. Lightweight, fast, portable. First release of https://4worlds.dev
repos.summary_zh: Inkwell是基于Rust+Tauri v2构建的轻量级Markdown编辑器，主打离线运行与极速启动（<1秒）。支持Mermaid图表、LaTeX公式、GitHub Flavored Markdown，提供4种主题与专注模式。100%本地存储，零遥测，安装包仅5-12MB。适用于跨平台写作，免费版功能完整，Pro版解锁PDF/HTML导出。
repos.summary_en: Inkwell is a sovereign Markdown editor built with Rust+Tauri v2, delivering <1s startup and offline-first operation. Features Mermaid diagrams, LaTeX math, GitHub Flavored Markdown, 4 themes, focus mode, and version history. 100% local storage, zero telemetry, 5-12MB footprint. Cross-platform for distraction-free writing. Free forever, Pro adds PDF/HTML export.

repos.description: 地址生成器:Random US tax-free state address generator with real OSM/USPS data — map-verified on Google Maps, supports global countries (HK, India, RU, etc.), multi-language (ZH/EN/RU/ES/PT), pure frontend, no server storage.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个纯前端的地址生成器，基于真实OSM/USPS数据生成美国免税州及多国地址，支持多语言且无需后端存储。核心亮点在于生成的地址可通过Google Maps验证，提供灵活的配置接口与模块化设计，适用于测试数据生成和隐私敏感场景。
repos.summary_en: A pure frontend address generator using real OSM/USPS data to create US tax-free state and global addresses. Features Google Maps-verifiable outputs, multilingual support, and zero server storage. Designed for test data generation with configurable data paths and modular architecture.

repos.description: Shadowfetch is a lightweight fetcher built with native TCP Sockets, for Cloudflare Workers.
repos.summary_zh: Shadowfetch 是 Cloudflare Workers 的隐私优先网络请求库，通过原生 TCP 套接字绕过内置 fetch 的元数据泄露问题。核心功能包括自动剥离 cf-ipcountry、cf-connecting-ip 等敏感头信息，确保用户 IP 与地理位置不被意外暴露。适用于需严格隐私保护的代理、镜像或数据转发场景，提供轻量级、可控的请求控制能力。
repos.summary_en: Shadowfetch is a privacy-focused fetcher for Cloudflare Workers that leverages native TCP sockets to prevent metadata leakage from built-in fetch. It sanitizes sensitive headers like cf-ipcountry and cf-connecting-ip, ensuring user IP and geolocation remain hidden. Ideal for privacy-sensitive proxying, mirroring, and data forwarding with minimal overhead and maximum control.

repos.description: TypeScript SDK for the NitroPing audit log — batching client, error capture, Hono/Express/Nitro adapters, and GenAI cost tracing.
repos.summary_zh: nitroping-sdk 是 nitroping.dev 平台的官方多语言客户端库，支持 TypeScript、Swift、Python、Go、Kotlin、PHP 等语言，封装 REST API 实现设备令牌注册（APNs/FCM/Web Push）、多渠道通知发送（推送、邮件、SMS、Slack）、定向/定时/循环推送、Web Push 订阅与 UI 组件、内置收件箱及 Webhook 验证。适用于移动/Web 应用与服务器端通知集成，提供统一 API、公私钥认证和幂等性支持，实现跨平台一致体验。
repos.summary_en: nitroping-sdk offers official client libraries for the nitroping.dev platform across TypeScript, Swift, Python, Go, Kotlin, and PHP. It wraps the REST API for device token registration (APNs/FCM/Web Push), multi-channel notifications (push, email, SMS, Slack), targeted/scheduled/recurring sends, Web Push subscriptions with UI widgets, in-app inbox, and webhook verification. Ideal for mobile/web apps and servers needing unified, secure cross-platform notification delivery with public/secret key auth and idempotency.
